articles.summary: Yes, if the AI checks its own work. An AI agent can read a QuickBooks Desktop company, map it and load NetSuite. A successful tool call does not prove that the books are right, so the agent must reconcile NetSuite against QuickBooks. Here is how superglue does it, starting from one portable company file (.QBM).
articles.title: Can AI migrate QuickBooks Desktop to NetSuite?

articles.summary: A .QBW file needs QuickBooks Desktop once, for a few minutes. Install the free 30-day trial of QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise, save the company as a portable company file (.QBM), and superglue reads the whole company from it.
articles.title: How to open a .QBW file without QuickBooks

articles.summary: Yes. superglue reads a QuickBooks Desktop portable company file (.QBM) without QuickBooks installed and returns the company data as records. Here is what you get, what you still need, and the other options.
articles.title: Can you open a .QBM file without QuickBooks?
